name: typescript-config
title: TypeScript Config
description: Shared tsconfig presets for the whole workspace. A `base` config carrying the strict, bundler-oriented defaults, plus per-target extends: `library` (source-export packages), `node` (Node-runtime packages), `react-library` (React component packages), and `nextjs` (App Router apps). Every other package extends one of these.
author: create-turbo-stack
docs: Extend the preset that matches the package: `{{scope}}/typescript-config/library.json` for source-export packages, `/node.json` for Node-only code, `/react-library.json` for React components, `/nextjs.json` for App Router apps. Each tsconfig.json adds only its own `include`/`outDir` on top.
